explanation: The upstream provenance handoff corrupts record identity by writing each evidence_sources.record_id as the source_id instead of the original demand record_id. Job 2 then cannot join provenance ranks to coverage rows by record_id, producing upstream_rank 0 for every priority. This violates the required preservation of deterministic provenance identities and upstream provenance order.
cited_evidence: assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, replacing demand record ids such as n06-r01 with source ids such as s01.
Job 1 output evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08 while the needs handoff contains record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources.record_id and looks up coverage.get('record_id'), so the mismatched identities make every observed priority upstream_rank equal 0.
